aibatcheditor-privacy-notice: Notice on Special:AIBatchEditor when the LLM is configured; explains that page wikitext is sent to the external AI provider.
aibatcheditor: The name of the special page and extension. Shown as the page title of [[Special:AIBatchEditor]].
aibatcheditor-summary: Intro text shown at the top of [[Special:AIBatchEditor]] explaining the workflow.
aibatcheditor-permission-denied: Error shown when a user lacks the required right. $1 is the name of the required user right ("aibatchedit").
aibatcheditor-loading: Placeholder text shown while the JavaScript UI loads.
aibatcheditor-nojs: Message shown to users who have JavaScript disabled.
aibatcheditor-error-no-input: API error when neither titles nor category is provided.
aibatcheditor-error-no-titles: API error when the resolved title list is empty.
aibatcheditor-error-batch-too-large:
API error. Parameters:
* $1 - Number of pages submitted
* $2 - Configured maximum
aibatcheditor-error-invalid-operation: API error. $1 is the unknown operation name.
aibatcheditor-error-operation-disabled: API error. $1 is the disabled operation name.
aibatcheditor-error-invalid-profile: API error. $1 is the unknown profile name.
aibatcheditor-error-category-not-found: API error. $1 is the category name.
aibatcheditor-error-llm-not-configured: API error when Grok/LLM credentials are missing from LocalSettings.php.
aibatcheditor-error-llm-request-failed: API error when the HTTP request to the LLM fails.
aibatcheditor-error-llm-invalid-response: API error when the LLM response cannot be parsed.
aibatcheditor-error-llm-empty-response: API error when the LLM returns no content.
aibatcheditor-error-llm-http: API error when the LLM HTTP request fails. $1 is the status code, $2 is the API message.
aibatcheditor-error-rate-limit: API error when the user exceeds the hourly AI request cap. $1 is the limit, $2 is used.
aibatcheditor-error-custom-needs-instruc: API error when operation=custom but instructions are empty.
aibatcheditor-error-templates-needs-name: API error when operation=templates but the templates parameter is empty.
aibatcheditor-error-templates-empty: Error when the templates list parses to zero names.
aibatcheditor-error-templates-too-many: Error when more than five template names are requested.
aibatcheditor-error-template-not-found: Error when a reference template page does not exist on the source wiki.
aibatcheditor-error-template-source-inva: Error when templatesource is not a valid HTTPS URL.
aibatcheditor-error-template-source-not-: Error when templatesource host is not allowlisted.
aibatcheditor-error-template-fetch-faile: Error when the remote MediaWiki API request for template content fails.
aibatcheditor-error-template-too-large: Error when fetched template wikitext exceeds the page size limit.
aibatcheditor-error-page-too-large: API error when page wikitext exceeds $wgAIBatchEditorMaxPageSize. $1 actual bytes, $2 limit.
aibatcheditor-error-instructions-too-lon: API error when AI instructions exceed $wgAIBatchEditorMaxInstructionsLength. $1 actual bytes, $2 limit.
aibatcheditor-error-diff-too-large: API error when diff original or proposed text is too large. $1 is the per-side byte limit.
aibatcheditor-error-edits-payload-too-la: API error when the save edits JSON payload is too large. $1 actual bytes, $2 limit.
aibatcheditor-error-save-proposed-too-la: API error when proposed wikitext on save exceeds $wgAIBatchEditorMaxPageSize. $1 actual bytes, $2 limit.
aibatcheditor-error-llm-http-generic: User-facing API error when the LLM HTTP request fails. $1 is the HTTP status code. Provider details are logged server-side only.
aibatcheditor-error-save-not-wikitext: Save error when the page main slot is not wikitext.
aibatcheditor-page-error-too-large: List validation detail when a page exceeds the size limit. $1 actual bytes, $2 limit.
aibatcheditor-page-error-not-readable: List validation detail when the user cannot read the page.
aibatcheditor-page-error-not-wikitext: List validation detail when the page main content model is not wikitext.
aibatcheditor-ui-retry-errors: Button to re-run AI processing on all pages that failed.
aibatcheditor-ui-retry-started: Notice when bulk retry of failed pages begins.
aibatcheditor-ui-retry-complete: Notice when bulk retry of failed pages finishes.
aibatcheditor-ui-too-large-skipped: Notice when pages are skipped at validation due to size limit. $1 count, $2 byte limit.
aibatcheditor-ui-operation-custom: Label for the custom AI operation that uses only user instructions.
aibatcheditor-ui-operation-templates: Label for the templates AI operation (insert, upgrade, clone transclusions).
aibatcheditor-ui-templates-label: Label for the reference template names field.
aibatcheditor-ui-templates-placeholder: Placeholder example for template names such as Ficha.
aibatcheditor-ui-templates-help: Help text for reference templates; mentions cloning from a source wiki.
aibatcheditor-ui-templatesource-label: Label for optional override of the remote template source wiki URL.
aibatcheditor-ui-templatesource-placehol: Placeholder URL for template source wiki.
aibatcheditor-ui-templatesource-help: Help text for template source wiki override field.
aibatcheditor-ui-category-truncated: Notice when a category has more eligible pages than the batch limit. $1 loaded, $2 total, $3 max batch.
aibatcheditor-ui-page-instructions-label: Label for per-page AI instruction override field.
aibatcheditor-ui-redraft: Button to re-run the AI on a single page.
aibatcheditor-ui-col-actions: Table column header for per-page action buttons.
aibatcheditor-ui-required-legend: Legend explaining that asterisk-marked fields are required.
aibatcheditor-ui-required-field: Tooltip and accessible name for the required-field asterisk.
aibatcheditor-ui-step-pages-title: Step 1 heading in the batch editor workflow.
aibatcheditor-ui-step-pages-desc: Step 1 description shown under the heading.
aibatcheditor-ui-step-operation-title: Step 2 heading in the batch editor workflow.
aibatcheditor-ui-step-operation-desc: Step 2 description shown under the heading.
aibatcheditor-ui-step-results-title: Step 3 heading in the batch editor workflow.
aibatcheditor-ui-step-results-desc: Step 3 description shown under the heading.
aibatcheditor-ui-stats-total: Summary pill showing total page count. $1 is the count.
aibatcheditor-ui-stats-changed: Summary pill showing changed page count. $1 is the count.
aibatcheditor-ui-stats-errors: Summary pill showing error count. $1 is the count.
aibatcheditor-ui-stats-pending: Summary pill showing pending page count. $1 is the count.
aibatcheditor-ui-diff-heading: Diff panel heading. $1 is the page title.
aibatcheditor-ui-hide-diff: Button to collapse a loaded diff preview.
aibatcheditor-ui-instructions-label: Label for the custom AI instructions textarea.
aibatcheditor-ui-instructions-placeholde: Placeholder example for custom AI instructions.
aibatcheditor-ui-instructions-help: Help text clarifying that AI instructions are separate from the wiki edit summary.
aibatcheditor-ui-profile-label: Label for the aggressiveness profile dropdown.
aibatcheditor-ui-profile-help: Fallback help under the profile dropdown when no localized or configured profile description is available.
aibatcheditor-ui-profile-desc-wikilinks-: Help text under the profile dropdown for wikilinks + conservative.
Help text under the profile dropdown for wikilinks + balanced.
Help text under the profile dropdown for wikilinks + aggressive.
aibatcheditor-ui-profile-desc-spellcheck: Help text under the profile dropdown for spellcheck + conservative.
Help text under the profile dropdown for spellcheck + balanced.
Help text under the profile dropdown for spellcheck + aggressive.
aibatcheditor-ui-profile-desc-formatting: Help text under the profile dropdown for formatting + conservative.
Help text under the profile dropdown for formatting + balanced.
Help text under the profile dropdown for formatting + aggressive.
aibatcheditor-ui-profile-desc-style-cons: Help text under the profile dropdown for style + conservative.
aibatcheditor-ui-profile-desc-style-bala: Help text under the profile dropdown for style + balanced.
aibatcheditor-ui-profile-desc-style-aggr: Help text under the profile dropdown for style + aggressive.
aibatcheditor-ui-profile-desc-templates-: Help text under the profile dropdown for templates + conservative.
Help text under the profile dropdown for templates + balanced.
Help text under the profile dropdown for templates + aggressive.
aibatcheditor-ui-profile-desc-custom-con: Help text under the profile dropdown for custom + conservative.
aibatcheditor-ui-profile-desc-custom-bal: Help text under the profile dropdown for custom + balanced.
aibatcheditor-ui-profile-desc-custom-agg: Help text under the profile dropdown for custom + aggressive.
aibatcheditor-ui-profile-conservative: Label for the conservative aggressiveness profile.
aibatcheditor-ui-profile-balanced: Label for the balanced aggressiveness profile.
aibatcheditor-ui-profile-aggressive: Label for the aggressive aggressiveness profile.
aibatcheditor-error-preview-needs-title: Error when the prompt preview API is called without a page title.
aibatcheditor-ui-preview-prompt: Button label to fetch and show the LLM prompt for the first selected page.
aibatcheditor-ui-preview-prompt-loading: Button label while the prompt preview API request is in progress.
aibatcheditor-ui-preview-prompt-notice: Notice that prompt preview is an optional debug feature; enable with $wgAIBatchEditorPromptPreview = true.
aibatcheditor-ui-preview-prompt-system: Heading for the system-role LLM prompt in the preview panel.
aibatcheditor-ui-preview-prompt-user: Heading for the user-role LLM prompt in the preview panel.
aibatcheditor-ui-preview-prompt-for: Heading above a prompt preview. $1 is the page title.
aibatcheditor-ui-preview-diff: Button label to load and show a wikitext diff for a changed page.
aibatcheditor-ui-diff-unchanged: Message when the diff API reports no changes.
aibatcheditor-diff-old-version: Diff header for the current wikitext. $1 is the page title.
aibatcheditor-diff-new-version: Diff header for the AI-proposed wikitext. $1 is the page title.
aibatcheditor-error-save-invalid-title: API error when a save request has an invalid title.
aibatcheditor-error-save-not-exists: API error when saving a page that does not exist.
aibatcheditor-error-save-redirect: API error when saving a redirect page.
aibatcheditor-error-save-not-editable: API error when the user cannot edit the page.
aibatcheditor-error-save-no-revision: API error when no revision exists for the page.
aibatcheditor-error-save-conflict: API error when the base revision no longer matches (edit conflict).
aibatcheditor-error-save-failed: API error when PageUpdater fails for an unknown reason.
aibatcheditor-error-save-missing-summary: API error when summary is empty on save.
aibatcheditor-error-save-no-edits: API error when the edits parameter is empty.
aibatcheditor-error-save-invalid-json: API error when the edits JSON is malformed.
aibatcheditor-error-save-invalid-draft-t: API error when the draft token is missing, expired, or does not match the proposal.
aibatcheditor-error-batch-missing-id: API error when batchid is missing on status poll.
aibatcheditor-error-batch-not-found: API error when the batch ID is unknown, expired, or owned by another user.
aibatcheditor-error-batch-invalid-page-i: API error when pageinstructions JSON is malformed.
aibatcheditor-ui-col-approve: Table column header for approving a proposed change.
aibatcheditor-ui-approve-label: Checkbox label to approve one page's proposed edit.
aibatcheditor-ui-approve-all: Checkbox label to approve all changed pages at once.
aibatcheditor-ui-approve-all-confirm: Browser confirm dialog before approving all changed pages. $1 is the page count.
aibatcheditor-ui-approve-without-diff-co: Browser confirm when approving one page without loading its diff.
aibatcheditor-ui-approve-all-without-dif: Browser confirm when approving multiple pages without loading diffs. $1 is the count.
aibatcheditor-ui-save-without-diff-confi: Browser confirm when saving approved pages without loading diffs. $1 is the count.
aibatcheditor-ui-warning-major-deletion: Warning shown when a proposal removes a large share of page content.
aibatcheditor-ui-warning-near-empty: Warning shown when a proposal leaves almost no content.
aibatcheditor-ui-warning-large-growth: Warning shown when a proposal adds a large amount of content.
aibatcheditor-ui-warning-section-removed: Warning shown when section headings were removed from the proposal.
aibatcheditor-ui-approve-with-warnings-c: Browser confirm when approving one page that has risk warnings.
aibatcheditor-ui-approve-all-with-warnin: Browser confirm when approving multiple pages with risk warnings. $1 is the count.
aibatcheditor-ui-save-post-heading: Heading above links shown after a successful save.
aibatcheditor-ui-save-post-revision-link: Link text to view the new revision. $1 is the revision ID.
aibatcheditor-ui-save-post-history-link: Link text to view the page history after save.
aibatcheditor-ui-draft-notice: Info notice before Draft. $1 pages/requests, $2 remaining quota, $3 hourly limit.
aibatcheditor-ui-draft-notice-insufficie: Warning when the batch exceeds remaining hourly AI quota. $1 needed, $2 remaining, $3 limit.
aibatcheditor-ui-save-approved: Button label to save all approved changes.
aibatcheditor-ui-save-started: Notice shown when saving approved edits begins.
aibatcheditor-ui-save-complete: Notice shown when all save operations finish.
aibatcheditor-ui-save-none-selected: Error when the user clicks save without approving any page.
aibatcheditor-ui-save-summary-required: Error when the user clicks save without an edit summary.
aibatcheditor-ui-status-saving: Status label while a page save is in progress.
aibatcheditor-ui-status-saved: Status label after a page was saved successfully.
aibatcheditor-ui-status-saved-detail: Detail text after a successful save.
aibatcheditor-ui-status-save-error: Status label when saving a page failed.
